description: Look up a SPECIFIC federal case or criminal defendant by docket number in the Federal Judicial Center's Integrated Database (FJC IDB) — civil case, criminal defendant, or appellate case. Needs a docket number plus a district (civil/criminal, FJC's own numeric district code) or circuit (appellate, FJC's own numeric circuit code). Returns filing/termination dates, nature-of-suit or offense code, disposition code, and (civil only) party names / judgment amount, or (criminal only) sentence terms. Complements court-listener (which has the docket TEXT and filings, not this statistical-outcome record). A no-match response names the filters tried. Periodic snapshot, refreshed on a schedule — the response carries `data_as_of`. Keyless.

case_type.description: Which FJC IDB dataset to search.

defendant_number.description: Criminal only: defendant number within a multi-defendant case (the IDB is defendant-level for criminal cases).

district_or_circuit.description: FJC numeric district code (civil/criminal) or circuit code (appellate) the case was filed in.

docket.description: Docket number, FJC's own format (as published in the IDB, not the PACER-formatted number).

fiscal_year.description: Narrow to one fiscal year, if known (recommended — the same docket can recur across years).

name: fjc_case_outcome_lookup
title: Fjc Case Outcome Lookup
